title: GANet: A Lightweight Group Attention Network for Plant Disease Identification on Embedded Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.30225v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Global warming and climate change are major catalysts for plant diseases, significantly affecting food production worldwide. Addressing this issue requires continuous monitoring and early detection of plant diseases. While recent advancements in deep learning offer potential solutions, most models demand high processing power and struggle to perform efficiently on low-end electronic hardware. Furthermore, many existing works focus on specific crop diseases, limiting their broader applicability. This paper presents a lightweight Group Equivariance Attention Network (GANet) designed for the prediction and monitoring of 38 types of plant diseases. GANet introduces a novel Group Attention block and Group-Wise Feature Fusion block, making it both sparse and efficient. translated_title: GANet：一种用于嵌入式系统植物病害识别的轻量级分组注意力网络
translated_abstract: 全球变暖和气候变化是植物病害的主要催化剂，严重影响着全球粮食生产。解决这一问题需要对植物病害进行持续监测和早期检测。尽管深度学习的最新进展提供了潜在的解决方案，但大多数模型需要较高的处理能力，难以在低端电子硬件上高效运行。此外，许多现有工作只专注于特定作物病害，限制了其更广泛的适用性。本文提出了一种轻量级的群等变注意力网络，专门用于38种植物病害的预测和监测。GANet引入了新颖的分组注意力模块和分组特征融合模块，使其既稀疏又高效。该模型仅有0.001M参数，在PlantVillage数据集上实现了99.99%的惊人准确率。此外，GANet针对在嵌入式系统等边缘设备上的部署进行了优化。
tldr: 本文提出仅含0.001M参数的轻量级分组注意力网络GANet，可在嵌入式边缘设备上高效识别38种植物病害，并在PlantVillage数据集上达到99.99%的准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GANet, a lightweight group attention network with only 0.001M parameters that efficiently identifies 38 types of plant diseases on embedded edge devices, achieving 99.99% accuracy on the PlantVillage dataset.
